indexes.name: idx_asset_file_hash
indexes.def: CREATE INDEX idx_asset_file_hash ON public.asset USING btree (file_hash)

indexes.name: asset_pkey
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX asset_pkey ON public.asset USING btree (asset_id)

indexes.name: idx_asset_right_level
indexes.def: CREATE INDEX idx_asset_right_level ON public.asset USING btree (right_level)

indexes.name: idx_asset_owner_time
indexes.def: CREATE INDEX idx_asset_owner_time ON public.asset USING btree (owner_id, created_at DESC)

indexes.name: idx_asset_pending
indexes.def: CREATE INDEX idx_asset_pending ON public.asset USING btree (created_at DESC) WHERE (audit_status = 'pending'::audit_status_enum)

indexes.name: idx_asset_motif
indexes.def: CREATE INDEX idx_asset_motif ON public.asset USING btree (motif_id) WHERE (motif_id IS NOT NULL)

indexes.name: idx_feature_vector_hnsw
indexes.def: CREATE INDEX idx_feature_vector_hnsw ON public.feature_vector USING hnsw (embedding vector_cosine_ops) WITH (m='16', ef_construction='64')

indexes.name: feature_vector_pkey
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX feature_vector_pkey ON public.feature_vector USING btree (fv_id)
